shared_elements: short horizontal parallel bars or bands
justification: The main overlap is generic: both surfaces include incised or outlined circular/oval forms, curving lines, and some short horizontal bars arranged around a central vertical axis. The biggest difference is that A is a dense, repeated vegetal/floral scroll ornament with palmette-like forms, while B depicts a single schematic anthropomorphic figure or statue-body with face/body markings, so the iconographic subject and scheme are fundamentally different.
